Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
